text: The Mystery Download. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Part of Wonder Quest Series.

Toby, Finn and Milo were playing at the Woodland Detective Club. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Toby was designing a shiny detective badge on the computer. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Finn was choosing its colours. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Milo was adding three tiny stars. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] It looks brilliant! said Toby.

Suddenly, a colourful box flashed on the screen. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Download your free detective game! [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Click now! [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Toby’s eyes grew wide. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] A free detective game! he cried. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Let’s download it!

Wait! said Finn. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] We don’t know where it came from. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Milo looked closely at the message. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] It doesn’t say who made the game, he noticed. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] And some of the words are spelled strangely.

The three friends searched for more clues. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Toby spotted a flashing button. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Finn noticed that the message said: [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Hurry! Download now! [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Milo found a tiny warning sign beside the file. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] This download feels mysterious, he said.

We should use our detective rule, said Finn. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Toby moved his paw away from the button. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] The friends went out into the garden to think about it. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] There, they reminded each other: [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Stop. Don’t click! [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Think. Is this download safe? [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Ask. Check with a trusted grown-up!

The friends asked Mrs. Hazel to come and help them. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] We found a free game, Toby explained. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] But we didn’t download it, added Finn. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] We thought it might not be safe, said Milo. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Mrs. Hazel smiled. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] That was a clever choice.

Mrs. Hazel examined the message. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] This is not from a trusted website, she explained. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Some mystery downloads can cause problems. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] They may damage a device or try to take private information. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Toby gasped. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] I’m glad we didn’t click!

Mrs. Hazel closed the strange message. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Then she showed them the Woodland Club’s approved games page. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] If you want to download something, she said, always ask a trusted grown-up to check it first. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Finn nodded. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] A colourful button does not mean a download is safe.

Mrs. Hazel helped them choose a safe detective puzzle. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Soon, Toby was following footprints. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Finn was matching secret symbols. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Milo was searching for tiny hidden clues. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] This game is fun, laughed Toby. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] And we know it is safe! said Finn.

Milo placed a red cross over the mystery download on their clue board. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Toby drew a green tick beside the trusted games page. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Finn wrote: [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Check before you download! [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] We solved the Mystery Download! they cheered.

Before downloading a game, picture or file: [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Stop. Do not tap the download button. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Think. Do you know and trust where it came from? [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Ask. Let a trusted grown-up check it first. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Toby, Finn and Milo raised their detective paws.
Lesson of the story is [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Stop. Think. Ask. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Before you download!
